name: tufte
title_zh: 把任何图表改造成信息密度最高的Tufte风格
tagline_zh: 嫌默认图表花哨又低效？让Edward Tufte的极简原则接管你的柱状图、仪表盘和热力图，数据墨水比拉满。
tagline_en: Tired of noisy charts? Let Tufte's minimalist principles take over your plots, dashboards, and heatmaps—maximize.
desc_en: Apply Edward Tufte's principles to any data visualization, chart, dashboard, or infographic. Use when the user asks to produce, design, critique, or improve a chart, graph, dashboard, KPI tile, table-with-data, sparkline, small multiple, time series, distribution plot, choropleth, or any other visual that communicates quantitative or categorical information. Also triggers on words like "visualize"
why_zh: 不是套模板，而是逐项审查你的图表：删网格线、去装饰、调对齐、提对比，把每一条像素都变成数据。
why_en: Not a template—it audits your chart element by element: strips gridlines, kills chartjunk, sharpens contrast, turns every pixel.
limit_zh: 只处理静态图表（PNG/SVG/PDF），不碰交互式仪表盘；需要你提供图表代码或图片路径，且默认不改变数据本身。
limit_en: Only static charts (PNG/SVG/PDF), not interactive dashboards; needs your chart code or image path; changes presentation, not data.
